question: Simplify the following. (1)/(5) div ((5)/(3) times (3)/(25))
solution:
**Calculation:**

(1)/(5) div ((5)/(3) times (3)/(25)) 

⇒ (1)/(5) div (1)/(5)

⇒ (1)/(5) times 5

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
